subject: planner: fix wrong empty projection (#53235)
summary: The change adds `addConstOneForEmptyProjection(p.children[0])` to `LogicalSelection.PruneColumns` so that when column pruning makes a Selection’s child an empty `LogicalProjection`, it is forced to project a constant `1` instead of remaining empty. This prevents downstream planning/execution paths that mishandle 0-column projections from producing incorrect results. A regression integration test for #49109 is added under `tests/integrationtest/.../planner_issue.test`.
